domain_note: Phase 4 scale-test seed anchors only. These are NOT part of the Phase 2 threshold-calibration eval set (data/eval_pairs.json) and must never be merged into it -- the 0.80 operating threshold is locked against that file's exact pair count and mix (see knowledge/learned.md section 11). These exist purely to give Phase 4's synthetic noise-perturbation step well-separated cluster centers: three fictional-product domains chosen to be genuinely distant, in embedding space, from the existing 67 SaaS-collaboration-tool anchors, so a noise cloud around one anchor doesn't accidentally drift closer to a different anchor than its own parent.
